title: Telegram Channel Scraper & Monitor
description: Reads posts from public Telegram channels. Add one or more channels and press Start.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Public Telegram channels to read. Enter a username (telegram), @username or a link (https://t.me/telegram). Private channels, groups, bots and invite links are not supported.

maxPostsPerChannel.title: Maximum posts per channel
maxPostsPerChannel.description: The newest posts are returned first. The run stops reading a channel after this many posts.

postsFrom.title: Posts from
postsFrom.description: Only posts published on or after this moment. Pick a date (2026-01-31) or a period counted back from now (7 days, 2 weeks, 1 month).

postsTo.title: Posts until
postsTo.description: Only posts published on or before this date (the whole day is included). Leave empty to start from the newest post.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Return only posts that contain at least one of these words or phrases. Letter case is ignored and parts of words match, so update also finds updates. The whole channel is read within your date range, and you pay only for matching posts.

onlyNewPosts.title: Only new posts since the last run
onlyNewPosts.description: Monitoring mode. The first run returns the newest posts. Every later run returns only posts published after the previous one. Combine it with a schedule to get a feed of new posts.
onlyNewPosts.sectionDescription: Turn the scraper into a monitor: schedule the run and receive only posts you have not seen yet.

monitorId.title: Monitor name
monitorId.description: Runs with the same monitor name share one memory of what was already delivered. Use different names when you track the same channel in several independent tasks.

includeMarkdown.title: Add Markdown version of the text
includeMarkdown.description: Adds a "markdown" field that keeps bold, italic, quotes, code and link targets. Useful for LLM and RAG pipelines.

includeHtml.title: Add original HTML of the text
includeHtml.description: Adds an "html" field with the post body exactly as Telegram renders it.

includeChannelDetails.title: Exact subscriber count
includeChannelDetails.description: Loads the exact number of subscribers for each channel (one extra request per channel). When off, the rounded number from the preview page is used, for example 9140000 for 9.14M.
